title: ID0455217-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P8 170000832] Power Convertor Issue
description:
Reported Behavior/Issue: Power Convertor 12 error flag:
Possible solution:
There are three possible solutions:
1) First, check the cables attached to that converter. If they are properly connected, proceed to the next step.
2) Please check the Fast-Shutdown as well.
3) Otherwise try swapping the converter that shows the issue with the one beside it. This will help confirm whether the problem lies in the cables or in the converter itself. If the issue remains after swapping, it confirms that the converter itself is faulty. In that case, replace the converter.
